questions.q: What did Technical Architecture's capstone already decide for Meridian Health Network, which this chapter does not revisit?
options: One ServiceNow instance with Domain Separation across three subordinate domains, plus a phased HR integration architecture
That HR service delivery should launch before IT Service Management
That Meridian should not consolidate its three hospital systems onto one platform at all
That each hospital system should keep its own separate ServiceNow instance
questions.explain: The instance-and-domain decision, and the integration architecture behind it, were finalized in Technical Architecture and are treated as fixed constraints here.

questions.q: How does this course's role differ from the role the Technical Architecture capstone put you in?
options: The role is identical; this course just repeats the same diagrams
You now implement a real, working capability within an already-approved architecture, instead of deciding what the architecture should be
You now redesign the instance-and-domain decision from scratch
You now only write documentation with no actual implementation planning
questions.explain: This chapter shifts from architecture decision-making to implementation planning for one concrete workstream inside a decision that's already final.

questions.q: Which workstream does this capstone scope as its first concrete deliverable, and why that one?
options: A unified IT Service Desk, because it carries no HIPAA-adjacent data, touches every employee, and tests whether the domain architecture holds up in practice
All three capability areas at once, enterprise-wide, in a single phase
HR service delivery, because it's the most complex of the three
Facilities management, because it was the board's top stated priority
questions.explain: Lower risk, high visibility, and a real-world test of the domain boundaries make the Service Desk the sounder first workstream, not an arbitrary one.

questions.q: Which description accurately matches a hospital system's current help-desk reality as this lesson presents it?
options: Lakeshore already shares one ticketing categorization scheme with St. Catherine's
Prairie View runs the most informal process of the three, reflecting its small IT staff and real wariness after a past forced consolidation
St. Catherine's has the least mature help-desk process of the three systems
All three systems already use the same ticketing tool today
questions.explain: St. Catherine's is the most mature and formal; Lakeshore is lighter but locally built with pride of ownership; Prairie View is the most informal and the most wary of a top-down platform change.

questions.q: What does this chapter's scope explicitly exclude, deferring it to later chapters?
options: Any discussion of the three hospital systems' current help-desk tools
Explaining why a unified Service Desk was chosen as the first workstream
Building the actual catalog items, workflows, and integrations for the Service Desk
Describing Meridian Health Network's organizational history
questions.explain: This chapter is discovery and planning only; actual configuration work is Chapter 5's job, once requirements and scope exist in writing.
